result.reason: The clause adopts most of the fallback: it is mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in performance, includes general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and contains no no-hire restriction. However, the 12-month period runs from expiration or termination of the Agreement, not from the end of each person's involvement in the services. This could restrict solicitation for substantially longer than 12 months after an individual's involvement ends, so it does not fully reach the fallback position. The changes are otherwise limited and professionally drafted.
